modules.title: Foundations
modules.description: The verb to be, personal pronouns and simple questions.

blocks.title: Explanation
blocks.body:
We use **to be** to talk about identity, age, origin, jobs and feelings. Its forms change with the subject: *I am*, *you/we/they are*, *he/she/it is*.

В русском языке глагол «быть» в настоящем времени обычно опускается («Я студент»), но в английском он обязателен: **I am a student.**
Contractions (I'm, you're, isn't) are normal in speech and informal writing.

blocks.title: Explanation
blocks.body:
Use the **Present Simple** for habits, routines and facts. Add **-s/-es** for *he, she, it*: *She works*, *He watches*.

Negatives and questions use **do/does**: *I don't drink coffee. Does she live here?*

questions.prompt: The room where you cook is the ___.

modules.title: Past events & plans
modules.description: Past Simple, going to, and talking about experiences.

blocks.title: Explanation
blocks.body:
The **Past Simple** describes finished actions at a specific time. Regular verbs add **-ed** (*worked*); irregular verbs have their own forms (*go → went*, *see → saw*).

Negatives and questions use **did** + base form: *I didn't go. Did you see it?*

blocks.title: Explanation
blocks.body: Use **be going to + verb** for plans and intentions decided before the moment of speaking: *I'm going to study tonight.*

questions.prompt: They ___ going to move next year.

modules.title: Experience & opinion
modules.description: Present Perfect vs Past Simple, giving opinions, linking ideas.

lessons.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
objectives: Choose between Present Perfect and Past Simple

blocks.title: Explanation
blocks.body:
**Present Perfect** (*have/has + past participle*) connects the past with now: life experience, recent results, unfinished time periods.

**Past Simple** is for finished time: *yesterday, in 2019, last week*.

Типичная ошибка русскоязычных студентов — *I have seen him yesterday*. Если время указано и закончилось, используйте Past Simple: **I saw him yesterday.**

items.ru: Я никогда не был в Японии.

questions.explanation: Life experience, no finished time → Present Perfect.
*yesterday* is a finished time → Past Simple.
*yet* goes at the end of questions and negatives.

lessons.title: Giving and supporting opinions
objectives: Support a view with a reason and example

blocks.body: A strong answer = opinion + reason + example. Practise this pattern on the Speaking page.
